title: show lists the evaluation records of an item's run, not only the newest, with each record's evaluator session, mode, attempt key and verdict summary
outcome: show lists the evaluation records of an item's run, not only the newest, with each record's evaluator session, mode, attempt key and verdict summary
acceptance: `show REF --evaluation RECORD_ID` returns one record complete, with every verdict, rationale and citation, so that an older evaluation can be read in full

a reader can tell from the window that two records came from the same evaluator session and in which order, and can compare that label with the holder's; no hash is used as identity, and ordinary `show` and `show --full` keep their newest-only meaning and their existing identity assertions

an explicit bounded window `show REF --evaluations [--after CURSOR]` lists the evaluation records of the item's active run, or of its latest run when the item is completed, in run-feed order, each with its record id, run position, mode, the evaluator's session as the stable display label that `show` already uses for sessions, the attempt key, created time, work revision, per-criterion verdict words up to a bound with the exact count of omitted verdicts, its stale reason computed at the read cut when it has one, the record it supersedes when it names one, and whether it is the newest; exact total, shown and omitted counts and a continuation are given, and a cursor from another cut or run is refused

nothing about admission, staleness or sealing changes: the newest whole record still decides, and an older record is not called stale merely because a later one exists; docs/features/acceptance-evaluation.md and docs/features/local-work-system.md describe both reads, and the mcp-dogfood suite covers an item with a failing record followed by a passing one from the same evaluator session
